<!-- prop-1: body_md -->
The expected variance in the Bayesian quadrature $\epsilon^{2}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}$  is the maximum mean discrepancy between the target distribution $p$ and $q_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}(x) = \sum_{n=1}^{N}w^{(n)}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}\delta_{x_n}(x)$
<!-- end prop-1 -->
<!-- proof-1: body_md -->
The proof involves invoking the representer theorem, using bilinearity of scalar products and the fact that if $f$ is a standard Gaussian process then $\forall g\in\mathcal{H}: \left\langle f,g\right\rangle \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\left\|g\right\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2)$:
\begin{align}
&\mathbb{V}_{} \left[ {Z_{f,p}\vert f_{x_1}, \dots, f_{x_N}} \right]=\\
	&= \mathbb{E}_{f\sim GP} \left( \int f(x) p(x) dx - \sum_{n=1}^{N}w^{(n)}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}} f(x_n)\right)^2\\
	&= \mathbb{E}_{f\sim GP} \left( \int \left\langle f, \phi (x)\right\rangle p(x) dx - \sum_{n=1}^{N}w^{(n)}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}} \left\langle f, \phi (x_n)\right\rangle\right)^2\\
	&= \mathbb{E}_{f\sim GP} \left\langle f ,  \int\phi(x) p(x) dx - \sum_{n=1}^{N}w^{(n)}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}\phi(x_n)\right\rangle^2\\
	&= \left\|\mu_p - \mu_{q_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}}\right\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2\\
	&= {\rm MMD}^2(p,q_{{\textsc{bq}}{}})
\end{align}
<!-- end proof-1 -->
<!-- prop-2: body_md -->
\label{prop:submodularity_SBQ}
$\epsilon^{2}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}(\emptyset)-\epsilon^{2}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}(\cdot)$ is a weakly submodular set function with constant $\epsilon<4r$, where $r$ is the incoherency
\begin{equation}
	r = \max_{x,x'\in\mathcal{P}\subseteq\mathcal{X}} \frac{k(x,x')}{\sqrt{k(x,x)k(x',x')}}
\end{equation}
<!-- end prop-2 -->
<!-- proof-2: body_md -->
By the definition of ${\rm MMD}$ we can see that
$-\epsilon^{2}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}} = -\inf_{w\in\mathbb{R}^N}\left\|\mu_p - \sum_{n=1}^N w^{(n)}_{{\textsc{bq}}{}}k(\cdot,{x}_n)\right\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2$ is the negative squared distance between the mean element $\mu_p$ and its projection onto the subspace spanned by the elements $k(\cdot,{x}_n)$. Substituting $k=1$ into Theorem 1 of \citet{KrauseCevher10} concludes the proof.
<!-- end proof-2 -->
